driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior targeting M1/car discharge headway (lower tau) and low early-start share. Increased minGap to reduce excessive braking delays while maintaining flow.
Highly impatient car archetype to match M2/early/car observed share (~0.011) by increasing early start probability (p=0.15).
Standard compliant motorcycle behavior targeting M1/moto discharge headway (observed mean 0.2957s) by reducing tau to 1.0 and aligning to the right side of the lane to reduce overshoot depth.
Slow motorcycle archetype to replicate M4/lat_moto (lateral position ~7m from origin) and M4/overshoot_share metrics by riding in lane center with slower acceleration.
Violating motorcycle archetype (custom1) that joins the 'moto_violator' distribution to model illegal left turns from HDT_N/S and queue seeking behaviors (M8/moto wrong-lane share).

traci_rules.rationale: Reduces early start creep probability (p=0.12) and window to bring M2/early/car share (target ~0.011) closer to observed while maintaining realism.
Lowers base red-light running probability (p0=0.2) and swarm effect (k=0.15) for standard motorcycles to match M3/share/moto (target ~0.098) and reduce total violations per cycle.
Adjusts box exit timing for illegal left-turning motorcycles to match M6/approach/l/moto entry timing (target ~53.58s) and reduce excessive holding times.

description: Adjusted archetype shares and rule probabilities to reduce red-light running, early starting, and queue-seeking behaviors while maintaining realistic discharge headways and lateral positioning for motorcycles.
